# Leski Karuchka / Лески Каручка

Website: https://leskikaruchka.com/

Leski Karuchka is a web application for requesting passenger transport, focused on Levski and the surrounding region in Bulgaria. Availability depends on participating carriers and authorised vehicles. “Karuchka” is a brand name.

Users select pickup and destination, view an estimated amount and send a request. Sending a request does not guarantee an available driver or a specific arrival time. For taxi transport, the carrier’s displayed tariff, taximeter and fiscal reporting rules determine the final fare. This version uses cash payment to the driver.
